title: もしも関ヶ原で西軍が勝っていたら｜東京は日本の中心にならなかった【もしも歴史】
promise: 関ヶ原で小早川秀秋が寝返らなかったら、豊臣秀頼・大坂・江戸・今の東京がどう変わったかが、本当にあった出来事を根拠に1本で分かる
desc:
もしも、1600年の関ヶ原で小早川秀秋が寝返らず、西軍が勝っていたら。家康は将軍にならず、江戸の海は埋め立てられず、大名が集まるのは大坂。東京が日本の中心にならなかった世界を、本当の出来事を手がかりに年を追ってたどります。

あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？ コメントで教えてください。

※小早川秀秋が寝返らず西軍が勝った所から先（家康が退く・秀頼が天下の主のまま・日比谷の入江が海のまま・1615年の大坂城・2つの未来）は作り話です。それより前は史実をもとにしています（日本大百科全書・ブリタニカ国際大百科事典・デジタル大辞泉・日本人名大辞典などの事典の本文）。
※映像とナレーションはAIを使って作っています。

world_rules: 変えたのは、小早川秀秋が寝返らず西軍が勝った、の1点だけ
1600年9月15日、松尾山の秀秋が決める時より前は史実どおり
秀秋の決断から先（家康が退く・秀頼が天下の主のまま・日比谷の入江が海のまま・1615年の大坂城・2つの未来）は作り話
この世界の人物は、本当の歴史（江戸幕府・大坂の陣・参勤交代）を知らない。本当の歴史と比べて言うのは語り手だけ
語り手が本当の歴史に戻るのは、章の終わりの1文（実際の歴史では〜）だけ
facts: 関ヶ原の戦い：1600年（慶長5年）9月15日、美濃の関ヶ原で、徳川家康の東軍と石田三成を中心とする西軍が戦った。両軍の兵力はともに8万前後でほぼ伯仲、西軍で実際に戦闘に参加したのは3万5000。家康の厳しい催促で小早川秀秋が寝返り、大谷隊の側背を攻撃したのが西軍総崩れの契機。午後4時ごろ東軍の大勝が決まった。三成は伊吹山で捕らえられ、小西行長・安国寺恵瓊らと京都で斬られた。中山道の秀忠軍は信州上田で真田昌幸に阻まれて戦機を逸した。毛利は安芸など9か国112万石から周防・長門2か国36万石へ。秀頼は摂津・河内・和泉65万石の一大名に。出どころ：コトバンク『関ヶ原の戦い』日本大百科全書（ニッポニカ） https://kotobank.jp/word/関ヶ原の戦い-86767
戦後の処分：改易91家420万石、減封4家（ブリタニカ国際大百科事典。同じページ）。台本では数を使っていない
毛利輝元は西軍の主将（ニッポニカ『大坂城にあった毛利輝元』）。防府市の歴史用語集は、三成が輝元を『総大将にたてて』兵を挙げたとする（同じコトバンクのページ）。輝元は7月19日に大坂城西の丸に入った（現代ビジネス 高橋陽介『シン・関ヶ原』抜粋 https://gendai.media/articles/-/159322 の検索の抜粋で確認）

小早川秀秋：1582年（天正10年）生まれ（精選版 日本国語大辞典）。『石田方に属したが、徳川方と通じ』（同）。戦後、備前・備中・美作に50万石（デジタル大辞泉）。慶長7年に21歳で死去し、嗣子なく断絶（日本大百科全書・日本人名大辞典）。コトバンク https://kotobank.jp/word/小早川秀秋 。関ヶ原の時18歳・秀吉の養子だったのち小早川隆景の養子（現代ビジネス https://gendai.media/articles/-/159482 系の記事の検索の抜粋）。1万5000の軍勢で松尾山に陣取り、黒田長政らの調略を受けていた（岐阜県観光連盟 https://www.kankou-gifu.jp/article/detail_65.html の検索の抜粋）
異説：寝返りと大谷勢の敗北を結びつける同時代の史料は無いとする研究者の指摘がある（現代ビジネス 高橋陽介の記事）。問鉄砲（家康が鉄砲を撃ち込んで秀秋をせかした話）は作り話ともいわれるので台本では使わない
五大老：『徳川家康、前田利家、毛利輝元、宇喜多秀家、小早川隆景（死後は上杉景勝）の五人』『秀吉が有力な大名を秀頼の後見として任じたもの』（精選版 日本国語大辞典）、『五奉行の上に置いた五人の大老』（デジタル大辞泉）。コトバンク https://kotobank.jp/word/五大老
豊臣秀頼：『文禄2年8月3日生まれ』『関ケ原の戦いののち65万石余の一大名に転落』『慶長20年5月8日大坂城内で母とともに自害』（デジタル版 日本人名大辞典+Plus）。コトバンク https://kotobank.jp/word/豊臣秀頼 。秀吉の死（1598年8月）の時5歳、関ヶ原の時7歳、1615年5月8日の時21歳（満の年齢で計算）
大坂城：『石山本願寺跡に、天正11年（1583）から3年かけて築いた』『元和元年（1615）大坂夏の陣で落城し焼失』（デジタル大辞泉）。コトバンク https://kotobank.jp/word/大坂城

日比谷：『江戸初期までは東京湾の入江であった』『徳川家康の江戸入府後に埋め立てられ』（精選版 日本国語大辞典）、『日比谷入江とよぶ東京湾の続きであった』（日本大百科全書）。コトバンク https://kotobank.jp/word/日比谷 。埋め立ては1592年に西丸の築城工事の残土で始まり、1603年から本格化。家康は1603年の開府から全国の大名に普請を命じた（三井住友トラスト不動産『このまちアーカイブス 日比谷』 https://smtrc.jp/town-archives/city/hibiya/index.html の本文）。家康の江戸入りは1590年（天正18年）
征夷大将軍：1603年（慶長8年）2月12日、家康は伏見城で将軍宣下を受けた（笠谷和比古の論文 nichibun.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/899/files/nk07005.pdf の検索の抜粋）。大坂の陣：1614年11月に大坂城を囲み、翌年5月に秀頼と淀君は自殺（山口県文書館の解説の検索の抜粋）
吉川広家：関ヶ原では西軍に属しながら徳川方と内通し、南宮山で毛利秀元の進軍を食い止めたとされる。戦後、毛利家は周防・長門の二国を保った（コトバンク https://kotobank.jp/word/吉川広家）
参勤交代：『寛永12年（1635）制度化され、1年おきの在府・在国を原則とした』。妻子は江戸に住むことを義務づけられた（デジタル大辞泉。コトバンク https://kotobank.jp/word/参勤交代）

江戸の人口：享保年間（1716〜1736）には100万人以上が住んでいたと広く考えられている（東京都立図書館『The Great Edo Metropolis』 https://www.library.metro.tokyo.jp/Portals/0/edo/tokyo_library/english/machi/page3-1.html の検索の抜粋）。東京都都市整備局の資料も『総人口は100万人を超える世界有数の大都市』とする。台本では『といわれる』
日比谷の名：海苔の養殖に使う木の枝『ヒビ』に由来するとされる（三井住友トラスト不動産『このまちアーカイブス 日比谷』 https://smtrc.jp/town-archives/city/hibiya/index.html?id=a01 の検索の抜粋）。台本では『ともいわれる』
ペリー来航：嘉永6年6月3日（1853年7月8日）浦賀沖に投錨（外務省『日本外交のあけぼの』 https://www.mofa.go.jp/mofaj/annai/honsho/shiryo/akebono/03.html の検索の抜粋）。台本では最後の章の2つの未来（作り話）の年にだけ使う

本物の画像（real）は Wikimedia Commons の検索 API で幅を確かめた（全部800px以上）：Sekigahara Kassen Byōbu-zu (Gifu History Museum) 7700px／Sekigaharascreen.jpg 3816px／Kobayakawa Hideaki 1.jpg 1152px／Ishida Mitsunari.jpg 1492px／Mori Terumoto.jpg 1725px／Joint letter of Five Elders (of Toyotomi).jpg 2801px／Toyotomi Hideyori 2.jpg 2550px／Toyotomi Hideyoshi (Kodaiji).jpg 1000px／Tokugawa Ieyasu.jpg 1340px／Osaka Castle Keep tower of camp screen of the Osaka summer 3101px／The Siege of Osaka Castle.jpg 12583px
一度だけ出る人物の見た目の英文は、全カットで一字一句同じにした：秀秋（A03・C01・C05・C07・J01）、三成（B05・D10・G06）、輝元（E02・G04）、子どもの秀頼（E03・E06）、大人の秀頼（H05・H06・H06b・J08）。家康は設定画のある ieyasu を chars に入れ、顔の説明は書いていない

cuts.narration: 味方だと思っていた山から、敵が来た。東軍の隊が、横から崩れていく。
cuts.image_en: Samurai soldiers turning in shock as a huge wave of enemy troops crashes into their flank from a mountain slope, banners falling, dust everywhere.
cuts.tts_text: 味方だと思っていた山から、敵が来た。とうぐんの隊が、横から崩れていく。
cuts.image: Samurai soldiers turning in shock as a huge wave of enemy troops crashes into their flank from a mountain slope, banners falling, dust everywhere.

cuts.narration: 山のふもとで踏んばっていた大谷吉継の隊も、前へ押し返した。
cuts.image_en: A samurai unit with plain white banners pushing forward at the foot of a mountain, spearmen advancing in a tight line, smoke and dust.
cuts.image: A samurai unit with plain white banners pushing forward at the foot of a mountain, spearmen advancing in a tight line, smoke and dust.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、秀秋は家康の催促で東軍に付き、この大谷隊の横を攻めている。
cuts.image_en: A painted folding screen view of a huge samurai battle on a plain, many banners and horsemen. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.tts_text: 実際の歴史では、秀秋は家康の催促でとうぐんに付き、この大谷隊の横を攻めている。
cuts.image: A painted folding screen view of a huge samurai battle on a plain, many banners and horsemen. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 午後。崩れていったのは、東軍の方だった。
cuts.image_en: Afternoon on a battlefield, a broken army of samurai fleeing east in disorder, abandoned plain banners on the ground, orange sun through smoke.
cuts.label: 崩れたのは東軍
cuts.tts_text: 午後。崩れていったのは、とうぐんの方だった。
cuts.image: Afternoon on a battlefield, a broken army of samurai fleeing east in disorder, abandoned plain banners on the ground, orange sun through smoke.

cuts.narration: 天下を分けた戦いは、朝に始まり、たった1日で決まった。
cuts.image_en: The sun setting red behind mountains over a quiet battlefield plain scattered with fallen plain banners and broken spears, no bodies, smoke thinning.
cuts.label: たった1日
cuts.image: The sun setting red behind mountains over a quiet battlefield plain scattered with fallen plain banners and broken spears, no bodies, smoke thinning.

cuts.narration: 家康の本陣にも、敗れた兵が次々に逃げ込んでくる。
cuts.image_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, rising from his camp stool in alarm as wounded-looking but bloodless soldiers stumble into his curtained headquarters. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Tokugawa Ieyasu, rising from his camp stool in alarm as wounded-looking but bloodless soldiers stumble into his curtained headquarters. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 退け。ここで死ねば、徳川は終わる。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of Tokugawa Ieyasu, gritting his teeth and pointing east, his face lit by the setting sun. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of Tokugawa Ieyasu, gritting his teeth and pointing east, his face lit by the setting sun. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 家康は、わずかな兵に守られて、東へ落ちのびていった。
cuts.image_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, galloping on horseback along a mountain road toward the east with a small group of guards, looking back over his shoulder. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Tokugawa Ieyasu, galloping on horseback along a mountain road toward the east with a small group of guards, looking back over his shoulder. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 東軍に付いた大名たちも、それぞれの国へ散り散りに逃げていった。
cuts.image_en: Small groups of defeated samurai on horseback scattering in different directions across hills at dusk, abandoned plain banners on the road.
cuts.tts_text: とうぐんに付いた大名たちも、それぞれの国へ散り散りに逃げていった。
cuts.image: Small groups of defeated samurai on horseback scattering in different directions across hills at dusk, abandoned plain banners on the road.

cuts.narration: さっきの問題。西軍8万のうち、実際に戦ったのは3万5千ほどとされる。
cuts.image_en: A group of samurai soldiers sitting idle on a hillside with their spears resting on the ground, watching the battle below without moving.
cuts.label: 3万5千
cuts.tts_text: さっきの問題。せいぐん8万のうち、実際に戦ったのは3万5千ほどとされる。
cuts.image: A group of samurai soldiers sitting idle on a hillside with their spears resting on the ground, watching the battle below without moving.

cuts.narration: 残りの兵の多くは、山の上や後ろの陣で、最後まで動かなかった。
cuts.image_en: A distant mountainside covered with motionless troops and plain banners, seen from the battlefield below through drifting smoke, late afternoon.
cuts.image: A distant mountainside covered with motionless troops and plain banners, seen from the battlefield below through drifting smoke, late afternoon.

cuts.narration: それでも西軍が勝てたのは、秀秋の1万5千が東軍の横を突いたからだ。
cuts.image_en: A wide view of a battlefield at sunset, the victorious army with plain banners standing on the field, a long column of troops coming down from a wooded mountain to join them.
cuts.tts_text: それでもせいぐんが勝てたのは、秀秋の1万5千がとうぐんの横を突いたからだ。
cuts.image: A wide view of a battlefield at sunset, the victorious army with plain banners standing on the field, a long column of troops coming down from a wooded mountain to join them.

cuts.narration: 家康の子・秀忠の大軍は、中山道を進んでいて、まだ着いていない。
cuts.image_en: A long army column of samurai marching through steep mountain valleys on a narrow road, banners hanging limp, autumn trees.
cuts.label: 秀忠の大軍
cuts.tts_text: 家康の子・秀忠の大軍は、なかせんどうを進んでいて、まだ着いていない。
cuts.image: A long army column of samurai marching through steep mountain valleys on a narrow road, banners hanging limp, autumn trees.

cuts.narration: 信州の上田で、真田昌幸に足止めされていたのだ。
cuts.image_en: A small mountain castle with stone walls and wooden gates, defenders on the walls firing at a large army camped below, autumn mountains behind.
cuts.label: 上田
cuts.image: A small mountain castle with stone walls and wooden gates, defenders on the walls firing at a large army camped below, autumn mountains behind.

cuts.narration: 三成は、静かになった野原を見渡した。
cuts.image_en: Ishida Mitsunari, a lean Japanese samurai commander about forty with a sharp narrow face, thin moustache and intense eyes, chonmage topknot, black lacquered armor under a plain white jinbaori surcoat, standing on a quiet battlefield at dusk with fallen plain banners around him, exhausted but relieved. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Ishida Mitsunari, a lean Japanese samurai commander about forty with a sharp narrow face, thin moustache and intense eyes, chonmage topknot, black lacquered armor under a plain white jinbaori surcoat, standing on a quiet battlefield at dusk with fallen plain banners around him, exhausted but relieved. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: これで、秀頼様の天下は守られた。
実際の歴史では、敗れた三成は捕らえられ、京都で斬られている。
cuts.image_en: An old painted portrait style image of a lean Japanese samurai in formal robes, seated. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 勝ったという知らせは、大坂城へ届いた。
cuts.image_en: A messenger on horseback galloping through the gate of a great Japanese castle with a tall black and gold keep, evening light, guards shouting.
cuts.image: A messenger on horseback galloping through the gate of a great Japanese castle with a tall black and gold keep, evening light, guards shouting.

cuts.narration: 城の西の丸には、総大将の毛利輝元が入っていた。
cuts.image_en: Mori Terumoto, a heavy-set Japanese lord about forty-seven with a round calm face and a small beard, chonmage topknot, formal dark green kimono and hakama, reading a blank report scroll in a castle room and smiling widely. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 西の丸
cuts.image: Mori Terumoto, a heavy-set Japanese lord about forty-seven with a round calm face and a small beard, chonmage topknot, formal dark green kimono and hakama, reading a blank report scroll in a castle room and smiling widely. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: そして本丸には、7歳の豊臣秀頼がいた。
cuts.image_en: Toyotomi Hideyori as a boy of seven, a chubby round-faced Japanese child lord with neatly tied hair, formal white and gold kimono, sitting on a raised dais in a golden castle hall, his mother in an elegant kimono beside him. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 7歳の秀頼
cuts.image: Toyotomi Hideyori as a boy of seven, a chubby round-faced Japanese child lord with neatly tied hair, formal white and gold kimono, sitting on a raised dais in a golden castle hall, his mother in an elegant kimono beside him. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 大坂城は、秀吉が石山本願寺の跡に、1583年から3年かけて築いた城だ。
cuts.image_en: A painted folding screen view of a tall black and gold castle keep above stone walls. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1583年
cuts.image: A painted folding screen view of a tall black and gold castle keep above stone walls. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 西軍が勝ったこの世界で、秀頼は豊臣の天下の主のままだ。
cuts.tts_text: せいぐんが勝ったこの世界で、秀頼はとよとみの天下の主のままだ。

cuts.narration: 金の天守の下で、城じゅうが勝ちの知らせに沸き立った。
cuts.image_en: Samurai retainers and court ladies cheering and raising cups of sake in a lantern-lit courtyard beneath a tall black and gold castle keep at night.
cuts.image: Samurai retainers and court ladies cheering and raising cups of sake in a lantern-lit courtyard beneath a tall black and gold castle keep at night.

cuts.narration: 大広間で、三成と秀秋が、幼い秀頼の前に頭を下げた。
cuts.image_en: Toyotomi Hideyori as a boy of seven, a chubby round-faced Japanese child lord with neatly tied hair, formal white and gold kimono, seated high on a dais while two armored samurai generals bow deeply before him in a huge golden hall. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Toyotomi Hideyori as a boy of seven, a chubby round-faced Japanese child lord with neatly tied hair, formal white and gold kimono, seated high on a dais while two armored samurai generals bow deeply before him in a huge golden hall. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 秀秋には、東軍の大名から取り上げた領地が与えられた。
cuts.image_en: A castle official unrolling a large blank map scroll of provinces on a tatami floor, samurai lords leaning in to look, lantern light.
cuts.tts_text: 秀秋には、とうぐんの大名から取り上げた領地が与えられた。
cuts.image: A castle official unrolling a large blank map scroll of provinces on a tatami floor, samurai lords leaning in to look, lantern light.

cuts.narration: 東軍に付いた大名の城は、次々に西軍の手に渡っていく。
cuts.image_en: Samurai soldiers with plain banners marching through an opened castle gate while the defenders kneel and hand over their weapons, calm, no fighting.
cuts.tts_text: とうぐんに付いた大名の城は、次々にせいぐんの手に渡っていく。
cuts.image: Samurai soldiers with plain banners marching through an opened castle gate while the defenders kneel and hand over their weapons, calm, no fighting.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、関ヶ原のあと、秀頼は65万石あまりの一大名に下げられた。
cuts.image_en: An old painted portrait style image of a young Japanese lord in formal court robes, seated. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 65万石
cuts.image: An old painted portrait style image of a young Japanese lord in formal court robes, seated. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: そのころ家康は、自分の城がある江戸に戻っていた。
cuts.image_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, standing on a wooden castle tower looking out at a wide shallow bay with marshes and fishing boats, wind in his haori, grim face. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Tokugawa Ieyasu, standing on a wooden castle tower looking out at a wide shallow bay with marshes and fishing boats, wind in his haori, grim face. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 家康が江戸に入ったのは、10年前の1590年。
cuts.image_en: A small simple castle on a low hill beside a marshy shore, a few thatched fishing huts and reed beds, a quiet early Edo landscape. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1590年
cuts.image: A small simple castle on a low hill beside a marshy shore, a few thatched fishing huts and reed beds, a quiet early Edo landscape. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: そのころの城の前には、日比谷入江という海が入り込んでいた。
cuts.image_en: A shallow inlet of the sea reaching right up to the stone walls of a castle, small boats and wooden fishing stakes in the water, reeds along the shore.
cuts.label: 日比谷入江
cuts.image: A shallow inlet of the sea reaching right up to the stone walls of a castle, small boats and wooden fishing stakes in the water, reeds along the shore.

cuts.narration: 埋め立ては1592年、城の西の丸の工事で出た土から始まっていた。
cuts.image_en: Laborers carrying baskets of earth on poles and dumping soil into the edge of a shallow inlet, a castle wall under construction behind them.
cuts.image: Laborers carrying baskets of earth on poles and dumping soil into the edge of a shallow inlet, a castle wall under construction behind them.

cuts.narration: それでも、入江の大半はまだ海。浅い海に、魚をとる舟が出ていた。
cuts.image_en: Fishermen in small wooden boats casting nets in a shallow bay, a castle on a low hill far behind them, morning mist over the water.
cuts.image: Fishermen in small wooden boats casting nets in a shallow bay, a castle on a low hill far behind them, morning mist over the water.

cuts.narration: だが、海を大きく埋めるには、全国の大名を工事に呼ぶ力が要る。
cuts.image_en: Thousands of laborers and samurai from many domains with plain banners cutting down a hill and carrying earth to fill a bay, a vast construction scene.
cuts.image: Thousands of laborers and samurai from many domains with plain banners cutting down a hill and carrying earth to fill a bay, a vast construction scene.

cuts.narration: この世界の家康は、天下の主ではない。関東の1人の大名だ。
cuts.image_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, sitting alone in a plain room of a small castle, looking at a blank map of the eastern provinces with a heavy expression. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Tokugawa Ieyasu, sitting alone in a plain room of a small castle, looking at a blank map of the eastern provinces with a heavy expression. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 大坂の命令でもない江戸の工事に、西の大名は1人も来なかった。
cuts.image_en: An empty construction site by the sea with idle tools, abandoned baskets and a half-built stone embankment, seagulls, gray sky.
cuts.image: An empty construction site by the sea with idle tools, abandoned baskets and a half-built stone embankment, seagulls, gray sky.

cuts.narration: 日比谷の入江は、半分だけ埋まったまま、潮の満ち引きを続けた。
cuts.image_en: A half-filled inlet at the foot of a castle, the earth embankment stopping in the middle of the water, tide flowing in, fishing boats floating quietly at sunset.
cuts.label: 入江は海のまま
cuts.image: A half-filled inlet at the foot of a castle, the earth embankment stopping in the middle of the water, tide flowing in, fishing boats floating quietly at sunset.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、1603年に家康が征夷大将軍となり、江戸に幕府を開いている。
cuts.image_en: An old painted portrait style image of a sturdy Japanese warlord in formal robes, seated. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1603年

cuts.narration: ここまで見てくださって、ありがとうございます。このチャンネルでは、毎回1つだけ歴史を変えてみています。気に入っていただけたら、チャンネル登録で応援してください。
cuts.label: チャンネル登録
cuts.tts_text: ここまで見てくださって、ありがとうございます。このチャンネルでは、毎回1つだけ歴史を変えてみています。気に入っていただけたら、チャンネル登録で応援してください。

cuts.narration: 関ヶ原から、まだ1年もたたない。勝ったはずの西軍にも、割れ目が入った。
cuts.image_en: Samurai lords in armor arguing angrily around a table in a castle hall, one slamming his fist, others turning away, lantern light.
cuts.tts_text: 関ヶ原から、まだ1年もたたない。勝ったはずのせいぐんにも、割れ目が入った。
cuts.image: Samurai lords in armor arguing angrily around a table in a castle hall, one slamming his fist, others turning away, lantern light.

cuts.narration: 関ヶ原で血を流したのは、三成や宇喜多、大谷たちの隊だった。
cuts.image_en: Tired samurai soldiers with dented armor and torn plain banners resting by a campfire after battle, bandaged arms, no blood visible.
cuts.image: Tired samurai soldiers with dented armor and torn plain banners resting by a campfire after battle, bandaged arms, no blood visible.

cuts.narration: 毛利の大軍は、南宮山の上から、最後まで下りてこなかった。
cuts.image_en: A large army with plain banners camped on a distant mountainside, sitting still and watching, smoke of battle far below.
cuts.label: 南宮山
cuts.tts_text: 毛利の大軍は、なんぐうさんの上から、最後まで下りてこなかった。
cuts.image: A large army with plain banners camped on a distant mountainside, sitting still and watching, smoke of battle far below.

cuts.narration: それでも毛利は、112万石の大大名。総大将として、大坂城にいる。
cuts.image_en: Mori Terumoto, a heavy-set Japanese lord about forty-seven with a round calm face and a small beard, chonmage topknot, formal dark green kimono and hakama, sitting at the head of a castle hall with arms folded, ignoring complaints. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 112万石
cuts.tts_text: それでも毛利は、112まんごくの大大名。総大将として、おおさかじょうにいる。
cuts.image: Mori Terumoto, a heavy-set Japanese lord about forty-seven with a round calm face and a small beard, chonmage topknot, formal dark green kimono and hakama, sitting at the head of a castle hall with arms folded, ignoring complaints. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 戦った者と、見ていただけの者。ほうびの分け方で、声が荒れた。
cuts.image_en: Two samurai generals in armor shouting at each other face to face in a castle corridor, retainers holding them back by the arms, lantern light.
cuts.image: Two samurai generals in armor shouting at each other face to face in a castle corridor, retainers holding them back by the arms, lantern light.

cuts.narration: 戦わなかった者に、同じほうびは出せぬ。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of Ishida Mitsunari, a lean Japanese samurai commander about forty with a sharp narrow face, thin moustache and intense eyes, chonmage topknot, black lacquered armor under a plain white jinbaori surcoat, shouting angrily in a lantern-lit castle hall. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of Ishida Mitsunari, a lean Japanese samurai commander about forty with a sharp narrow face, thin moustache and intense eyes, chonmage topknot, black lacquered armor under a plain white jinbaori surcoat, shouting angrily in a lantern-lit castle hall. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 関東には、まだ家康が生きている。秀頼は、まだ子ども。
cuts.image_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, sitting alone by a brazier in a dark castle room in winter, quietly watching the fire, a faint knowing smile. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Tokugawa Ieyasu, sitting alone by a brazier in a dark castle room in winter, quietly watching the fire, a faint knowing smile. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 家康が江戸で力をためて、もう一度、西へ攻めてくるかもしれない。
cuts.image_en: Eastern samurai troops drilling with spears and muskets in a wide field below a small castle in the winter wind, plain banners, gray sky.
cuts.image: Eastern samurai troops drilling with spears and muskets in a wide field below a small castle in the winter wind, plain banners, gray sky.

cuts.narration: 大坂の町には、兵を連れた大名が次々に集まってきた。
cuts.image_en: Columns of armored samurai with different plain banners marching into a crowded merchant town below a great castle, townspeople pressing against the walls to make way.
cuts.image: Columns of armored samurai with different plain banners marching into a crowded merchant town below a great castle, townspeople pressing against the walls to make way.

cuts.narration: また戦の世に戻るのか。町の人は、店の戸を閉め始めた。
cuts.image_en: Frightened merchants hurriedly closing the wooden shutters of their shops in a darkening street, a mother pulling her child inside, soldiers passing in the background.
cuts.label: また戦の世へ？
cuts.image: Frightened merchants hurriedly closing the wooden shutters of their shops in a darkening street, a mother pulling her child inside, soldiers passing in the background.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、毛利は周防と長門の36万石に減らされている。
cuts.image_en: A small provincial castle town by the sea in western Japan, quiet and modest, evening light. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 36万石
cuts.tts_text: 実際の歴史では、毛利はすおうと長門の36まんごくに減らされている。
cuts.image: A small provincial castle town by the sea in western Japan, quiet and modest, evening light. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 割れかけた大名たちを止めたのは、1枚の書状だった。
cuts.image_en: An old Japanese document written with brush, several signatures with seals side by side at the end, on aged paper.
cuts.label: 大老の書状
cuts.image: An old Japanese document written with brush, several signatures with seals side by side at the end, on aged paper.

cuts.narration: 大事なことは、大老たちが名を並べて決める。秀吉が残した決まりだ。
cuts.image_en: Several Japanese lords in formal kimono taking turns signing the same long blank paper with brushes in a quiet castle room, lantern light.
cuts.image: Several Japanese lords in formal kimono taking turns signing the same long blank paper with brushes in a quiet castle room, lantern light.

cuts.narration: 秀頼が大人になるまで、大名どうしで戦はしない。毛利も宇喜多も、名を書いた。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of a hand pressing a red seal onto a long blank paper next to several brush signatures, on a black lacquered desk, lantern light.
cuts.image: Close-up of a hand pressing a red seal onto a long blank paper next to several brush signatures, on a black lacquered desk, lantern light.

cuts.narration: 大名が手を組めば、関東の家康も、もう一度攻めては来られない。
cuts.image_en: Tokugawa Ieyasu, reading a blank letter by lamplight in his Edo castle, slowly lowering it with a tired sigh. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Tokugawa Ieyasu, reading a blank letter by lamplight in his Edo castle, slowly lowering it with a tired sigh. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: そして15年がたった。1615年5月8日。秀頼は21歳になっていた。
cuts.image_en: Early summer morning over a great castle with a tall black and gold keep, green trees, clear sky, peaceful.
cuts.label: 1615年5月8日
cuts.image: Early summer morning over a great castle with a tall black and gold keep, green trees, clear sky, peaceful.

cuts.narration: 大きな体の若者が、天守から城下を見下ろす。
cuts.image_en: Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, standing at the high balcony of a castle keep looking down at the town. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, standing at the high balcony of a castle keep looking down at the town. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 父上の城に、戦の煙は上がっておらぬ。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, smiling calmly in the summer breeze. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, smiling calmly in the summer breeze. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 大人になった秀頼は、大老たちの書状に、自分の名を書き添えた。
cuts.image_en: Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, signing a long blank paper with a brush while older lords watch respectfully. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, signing a long blank paper with a brush while older lords watch respectfully. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 大坂城は燃えていない。城下には、物売りの声が響いていた。
cuts.image_en: A great castle with a tall black and gold keep standing intact above a bustling merchant town in early summer, crowded streets, peddlers, boats on the river, bright warm sunlight.
cuts.label: 大坂城は燃えなかった
cuts.image: A great castle with a tall black and gold keep standing intact above a bustling merchant town in early summer, crowded streets, peddlers, boats on the river, bright warm sunlight.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、この日、秀頼は大坂城の中で、母とともに亡くなっている。
cuts.image_en: A painted folding screen view of a great castle surrounded by besieging armies. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 大坂の陣
cuts.image: A painted folding screen view of a great castle surrounded by besieging armies. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 将軍のいないこの世界で、大名たちが通う先は大坂だった。
cuts.chapter: 東京にならなかった町
cuts.image_en: A long daimyo procession with plain banners and palanquins entering a great castle town on a river, crowds of townspeople watching, bright day.
cuts.image: A long daimyo procession with plain banners and palanquins entering a great castle town on a river, crowds of townspeople watching, bright day.

cuts.narration: 大名が1年おきに江戸で暮らす、参勤交代。この世界には、その決まりが無い。
cuts.image_en: An empty highway lined with pine trees leading toward a distant small castle town in the east, no travelers, quiet afternoon.
cuts.label: 参勤交代なし
cuts.image: An empty highway lined with pine trees leading toward a distant small castle town in the east, no travelers, quiet afternoon.

cuts.narration: 大名の妻や子どもが住む屋敷も、江戸ではなく大坂に建った。
cuts.image_en: Rows of large samurai mansions with white walls and tiled gates lining a wide street near a great castle, servants coming and going.
cuts.image: Rows of large samurai mansions with white walls and tiled gates lining a wide street near a great castle, servants coming and going.

cuts.narration: 大名と家来が集まる町には、商人も職人も集まってくる。
cuts.image_en: A huge crowded castle town on a river seen from above, endless tiled roofs, bridges and canals, busy streets, a great black and gold castle keep in the center.
cuts.image: A huge crowded castle town on a river seen from above, endless tiled roofs, bridges and canals, busy streets, a great black and gold castle keep in the center.

cuts.narration: 日本じゅうの人の流れが、この世界では大坂へ向かった。
cuts.image_en: Crowds of travelers, merchants and porters walking along a highway toward a great castle town on a river, carrying loads, morning sun.
cuts.image: Crowds of travelers, merchants and porters walking along a highway toward a great castle town on a river, carrying loads, morning sun.

cuts.narration: 江戸は、関東の大名・徳川家の城下町のままだ。
cuts.image_en: A modest castle town beside a marshy bay, a small castle on a hill, thatched houses and rice fields, quiet afternoon.
cuts.tts_text: 江戸は、関東の大名・とくがわけの城下町のままだ。
cuts.image: A modest castle town beside a marshy bay, a small castle on a hill, thatched houses and rice fields, quiet afternoon.

cuts.narration: 城の前の日比谷の入江も、海のまま残った。
cuts.image_en: A shallow sea inlet reaching the stone walls of a castle, fishing boats and wooden stakes in the water, herons standing in the shallows, calm evening.
cuts.label: 日比谷は海のまま
cuts.image: A shallow sea inlet reaching the stone walls of a castle, fishing boats and wooden stakes in the water, herons standing in the shallows, calm evening.

cuts.narration: 日比谷という名は、海苔をとるために海に立てた枝、ひびから来たともいわれる。
cuts.image_en: Rows of thin wooden branches and bamboo stakes standing in a shallow calm sea for growing seaweed, a fisherman in a small boat tending them, morning light.
cuts.label: ひび
cuts.image: Rows of thin wooden branches and bamboo stakes standing in a shallow calm sea for growing seaweed, a fisherman in a small boat tending them, morning light.

cuts.narration: 今の日比谷公園のあたりには、漁の小舟が浮かんでいる。
cuts.image_en: Small wooden fishing boats floating on a calm shallow bay at sunset, fishermen pulling nets, a castle wall in the distance.
cuts.image: Small wooden fishing boats floating on a calm shallow bay at sunset, fishermen pulling nets, a castle wall in the distance.

cuts.narration: この世界の東京は、日本の中心にならなかった。
cuts.label: 東京は中心にならなかった

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、江戸は18世紀に100万人を超える町になったといわれる。
cuts.image_en: A huge crowded Edo period city seen from above, endless tiled roofs, bridges and canals, busy streets, Edo castle in the distance. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 100万人
cuts.image: A huge crowded Edo period city seen from above, endless tiled roofs, bridges and canals, busy streets, Edo castle in the distance. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 変えたのは、松尾山の1つの決断だけだった。
cuts.image_en: Kobayakawa Hideaki, a slim pale Japanese samurai lord of eighteen with a boyish face and anxious eyes, chonmage topknot, dark red lacquered armor under a plain crimson jinbaori surcoat, standing alone on a mountain top at sunset, looking over a wide quiet plain. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.tts_text: 変えたのは、まつおやまの1つの決断だけだった。
cuts.image: Kobayakawa Hideaki, a slim pale Japanese samurai lord of eighteen with a boyish face and anxious eyes, chonmage topknot, dark red lacquered armor under a plain crimson jinbaori surcoat, standing alone on a mountain top at sunset, looking over a wide quiet plain. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 実際の秀秋は、関ヶ原の2年後に21歳で亡くなった。跡継ぎはなく、小早川家は絶えている。
cuts.image_en: A quiet small grave stone under autumn trees at a temple, fallen red leaves, soft evening light. No people. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.tts_text: 実際の秀秋は、関ヶ原の2年後に21歳で亡くなった。跡継ぎはなく、小早川けは絶えている。
cuts.image: A quiet small grave stone under autumn trees at a temple, fallen red leaves, soft evening light. No people. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: その先の日本は、2つの方へ分かれていく。
cuts.image_en: A mountain road splitting into two paths at a crossroads, one leading to a sunny castle town, the other into dark stormy hills, evening.
cuts.image: A mountain road splitting into two paths at a crossroads, one leading to a sunny castle town, the other into dark stormy hills, evening.

cuts.narration: 良い未来。1853年に黒船が来た時、大坂の大老たちが1つの声で向き合う。
cuts.image_en: Several Japanese lords in formal kimono sitting together calmly at a long table in a castle hall, facing foreign naval officers across the table, mutual respect, warm light.
cuts.label: 良い未来
cuts.image: Several Japanese lords in formal kimono sitting together calmly at a long table in a castle hall, facing foreign naval officers across the table, mutual respect, warm light.

cuts.narration: 戦うことなく、話し合いで港を開いた。
cuts.image_en: Black steam warships anchored in a calm bay while small Japanese boats row out peacefully to meet them, clear morning.
cuts.image: Black steam warships anchored in a calm bay while small Japanese boats row out peacefully to meet them, clear morning.

cuts.narration: 悪い未来。1853年に黒船が来た時、日本は大名ごとに割れていた。
cuts.image_en: Black steam warships anchored offshore while on the beach several groups of samurai with different plain banners argue and turn their backs on each other, stormy sky.
cuts.label: 悪い未来
cuts.image: Black steam warships anchored offshore while on the beach several groups of samurai with different plain banners argue and turn their backs on each other, stormy sky.

cuts.narration: まとまって話せる相手は、どこにもいなかった。
cuts.image_en: A foreign naval officer in a dark uniform standing alone on a beach holding a sealed blank letter, looking at empty Japanese shore huts, stormy sky.
cuts.image: A foreign naval officer in a dark uniform standing alone on a beach holding a sealed blank letter, looking at empty Japanese shore huts, stormy sky.

cuts.narration: あなたは、どっちの日本になったと思いますか。
cuts.label: どっちの日本？

cuts.narration: あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？コメントで教えてください。
cuts.image_en: Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, standing on a castle wall at sunset looking toward the east. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Toyotomi Hideyori at twenty-one, a tall broad-shouldered Japanese young lord with a full round face, chonmage topknot, formal white kimono with a gold-trimmed haori, standing on a castle wall at sunset looking toward the east. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: それでは、また次の世界線で。

style_en: Japanese historical gekiga manga illustration: bold confident ink outlines, heavy dramatic shadows, rich warm colors of paper lanterns and sunset, painted backgrounds of feudal Japan, intense exaggerated facial expressions. Hand-drawn look, never glossy or 3D. Original style that does not resemble any famous anime, manga or video game.
